context.problem_statement: Calculate alpha diversity metrics for microbiome samples from two patient groups (Healthy vs IBD). For each sample, compute: (1) Shannon entropy H = -sum(p_i * log(p_i)) where p_i is relative abundance of species i, (2) Simpson's diversity index D = 1 - sum(p_i^2), (3) species richness (number of species with count > 0). Compare the mean Shannon entropy between Healthy and IBD groups using a Mann-Whitney U test. Report whether diversity is significantly different (p < 0.05).
context.expert_knowledge: Shannon entropy ranges from 0 (one species dominates) to log(S) where S is species count (maximum evenness). IBD patients typically show reduced microbial diversity (dysbiosis). Use scipy.stats.mannwhitneyu for non-parametric comparison since diversity scores may not be normally distributed. Use natural logarithm for Shannon entropy.
